verdict.rationale: MoQ Relay is a real-time media relay, and SIP or PSTN bridging is a fair axis for real-time media infrastructure. The evidence pack documents ingest via OBS, ffmpeg, GStreamer, HLS and WebRTC players, but never mentions SIP, PSTN, or phone dial-in or dial-out. Absence of evidence for an applicable capability yields none.

support.subject: As a developer, phone callers join a session through documented SIP or PSTN dial-in and dial-out
